CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_dealmachine_capacity_available(p_requests integer DEFAULT 2)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.icash_dealmachine_capacity_available(p_requests,null::uuid);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_owner_enrichment_unstarted(p_account uuid, p_screening uuid, p_operation text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p_account is not null and p_screening is not null and p_operation='owners:'||p_account||':'||p_screening
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend where operation_key=p_operation)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_credit_reservations where operation_key=p_operation)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_cost_observations where event_key collate "C"=p_operation collate "C")
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_cost_observations where event_key collate "C">=(p_operation||':') collate "C" and event_key collate "C"<(p_operation||';') collate "C")
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_cost_observations where source_ref collate "C"=('dealmachine:owners:'||p_operation) collate "C")
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_cost_observations where source_ref collate "C">=('dealmachine:owners:'||p_operation||':') collate "C" and source_ref collate "C"<('dealmachine:owners:'||p_operation||';') collate "C")
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_cost_manifests where operation_key=p_operation)
 and not exists(select 1 from icash_private.provider_costs where operation_key=p_operation)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_owner_contacts where screening_id=p_screening or operation_key=p_operation)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations where operation_key=p_operation or (account_id=p_account and screening_id=p_screening))
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operational_contacts where account_id=p_account and screening_id=p_screening)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_permissions where account_id=p_account and screening_id=p_screening);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_research_private.unknown_export_late_capacity_blocked()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from icash_research_private.unknown_export_late_holds h
  join icash_research_private.owner_exports e on e.id=h.export_id
  where e.terminal_at is null);
$function$
